settings.agentAllowedToolsDesc: Limit which built-in tools and Skill the conversation Agent can use. Turning this off keeps current capabilities and does not affect in-flight requests.
settings.agentAllowedToolsEnableDesc: When enabled, only the checked tools are visible to the model. This does not bypass permission approval.
settings.agentAllowedToolsMcpNote: Session MCP tools stay managed by the conversation MCP picker and are not controlled here.

settings.chatStreamTimeoutsDesc: Set first-packet and idle wait times for model streaming responses. Enter 0 to disable a timeout.
settings.chatStreamFirstPacketTimeoutDesc: Maximum seconds to wait for the first streaming response chunk after sending a request.

settings.mcpToolLoopMaxIterationsDesc: Limits how many consecutive MCP tool-call rounds a single response may run. Higher values can increase latency, token usage, and tool execution cost.
